title: Love Them
text: Love Them. Love these, am planning to buy a set for all my friends and family!! Really I am not being paid nor did I receive this item free in exchange for a good review. product_metadata.title: Gravity Electric Salt and Pepper Grinder Set with Adjustable Coarseness Automatic Pepper and Salt Mill Battery Powered with Blue LED Light,One Hand Operated,Brushed Stainless Steel by CHEW FUN
features: ✅✅【UNIQUE DESIGN】This electric pepper grinder has a wide mouth spice container, brushed stainless steel body for corrosion protection, adjustable ceramic blades, and refillable - just unscrew the stainless steel top to easily fill it without confusion. Modern and stylish design is a perfect complement to any kitchen and a great gift.

✅✅【AUTOMATIC OPERATION】Our gravity salt and pepper grinder set allow you will not need both of your hands to grind your spices. Better than other brands;you won’t even need to install the batteries! Simply flipped the grinder and you will have fresh ground spices! Convenient and funny.

✅✅【ADJUSTABLE MILL】Electric pepper grinder with adjustable grinder,just turn the white knob on top of salt or pepper mill,you can easily adjust the grinder knob to choose the coarseness of your spice,salt or peppercorn.Many grinding levels for your choice allows you to grinder your spices from coarse to fine.

✅✅【BLUE LED LIGHT】Why our automatic pepper mill choose blue LED light? Blue light is not only bright but gentle,You can't imagine how warm and romantic it will be when you have dinner with family or lover.The blue light will turn ON with a simple wrist twist,you will easily be able to see amount of salt and pepper you put in your food.

✅✅【100% SATISFACTION GUARANTEED】Our electric salt and pepper grinder offers a whole year warranty and lifetime support, you can request a full refund within 30 days of your order. totally no risk for you!
